info.name: Groceries
info.summary: Shared shopping lists for the whole family, as an installable mobile app
info.description:
Shared shopping lists for desktop and Android & iOS.
- Items grouped by category and sorted by the aisle order of the store you are in - Multiple lists (groceries, pharmacy, hardware store …) shared with users or groups - List or icon grid view, history of previously bought items, 600+ built-in items with synonyms and brand names - Available in 20 languages - Live updates when family members add or tick items - Install to the home screen on your phone, log in once, stay logged in (per-device app password) - Statistics per list and a yearly review - Works offline in the store and syncs when back online - API for other apps (e.g. Cookbook) to add recipe ingredients
info.author: Marc Kammermann
